lf-file-editor.description: An editor for the bound UTF-8 files on the machine serving the page, one open at a time, saving as the user types.
lf-file-editor.x-instructions: Write the element empty, and bind each id in `binding` to a file with `leaf file bind PAGE BINDING PATH`. Name several ids to edit several files; a `lf-file-tree` whose `for` names this editor lists them and opens the one picked.
